meta.title: Egor Morozov — Frontend Developer
meta.description: Frontend developer with 6 years of experience in React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vue and Angular. Owning system design and delivery from product requirements to CI/CD and production monitoring.

hero.summary: With {years} years of experience, I drive technical decision-making and take full ownership of system design and delivery, from translating product requirements into solutions to CI/CD pipelines and production monitoring.

salmon.description: Built a loan application from scratch. Migrated a large news portal from Tilda to a custom solution using Strapi and Next.js. Designed the CMS architecture and reusable content blocks. Improved key business metrics through performance optimizations, including Redis-based request caching (SLA ~99.9%). Built a scalable UI Kit based on MUI components, documented in Storybook and covered with unit and visual regression tests. Extended Strapi core functionality by developing custom plugins (view-preview-block, reset-web-cache, duplicate-block-content), improving editorial workflows and system maintainability.

reelmotion.description: Combined hands-on development with technical leadership, building complex UI components, ensuring payment system reliability via unit and E2E tests, and improving Lighthouse performance scores from 68 to 93.

crimtan.description: Migrated core functionality from AngularJS to Angular (2+). Improved backend form engine typing and optimized tree path resolution, significantly increasing stability and availability, with 1.5x performance improvements confirmed under stress testing.

javaMentor.description: Engineered a web application for IT education with a strong focus on usability and performance. Cut bundle size by half and improved TTI by 20%. Designed a modular modal factory leveraging React Portal and independent widgets. Supported role-based platform features and migrated legacy JavaScript code to TypeScript.

kata.description: Led and scaled mentorship for hundreds of students, conducting in-depth code reviews and regular 1-on-1 sessions. Guided learners through their full educational journey, advising on modern web development practices and helping design effective, individualized learning plans.

apm.description: Bachelor's degree, higher education — information systems and technology.

kotin.description: Secondary education — engineering technology / mechanical engineering.
